weather.settingsHint: Show live weather in the pet panel. The city is configurable; data comes from Open-Meteo and needs no API key.
weather.notConfigured: Enter a city in settings, then refresh the weather.
weather.cityNotFound: City “{city}” not found. Please check the name.
weather.networkError: Network request failed. Please try again later.
weather.invalidResponse: The weather service returned an unexpected response.

settings.title: Settings
settings.themeHint: Switch the UI look: dark uses restrained glassmorphism, light uses a bright panel. The choice persists after restart.
settings.reduceMotionHint: Turn off the pet's breathing/blinking, transitions and effects to reduce visual stimulation.
settings.idleEnabledHint: When there has been no interaction for a while, the pet may proactively send a bubble. Saved on submit and can be turned off anytime.
settings.ttsVoicePackEnabledHint: Use a personality-matched Edge neural voice (pitch/speed) online; it falls back to the system voice when offline or on failure. Turn off to use the system default TTS.
settings.ttsVoicePackHint: Leave empty to switch automatically with the active personality template, or pick one fixed voice pack.
settings.telemetryEnabledHint: Helps improve the product using aggregate stats only (counts/durations/tiers). Never includes chat content, keys, or file paths.
settings.telemetryPrivacy: Off by default and can be turned off anytime. "Turn off & clear" deletes the local telemetry data immediately. The upload endpoint is empty by default, so nothing is ever uploaded unless configured.
settings.telemetryCleared: Telemetry turned off and local data cleared
settings.telemetryOnboardingHint: Optional. Off by default; when enabled, only aggregate usage stats (counts/durations/tiers) are collected — never chat content, keys, or file paths.
settings.apiKeyHint: The key is stored only on this device and is used only to call the DeepSeek API.
settings.backstoryPlaceholder: I am your AI pet. I love chatting with you and remembering the little things that matter…
settings.saved: Saved. The key is stored only on this device and will persist after restart.
settings.note: Settings are saved locally through petAPI.settings and persist after restart. Traits, tone and backstory shape your pet's conversation personality.
settings.memoryHint: Long-term memories are extracted from your chats automatically. View, edit, or delete them here.
settings.memoryEmpty: No long-term memories yet. Key facts from chats will be saved here automatically.
settings.memoryUnavailable: Memory management is unavailable (petAPI.memory is not provided).
settings.memoryNotFound: Memory not found; it may have been deleted

water.title: Water reminder
water.settingsHint: Remind you to drink water at a chosen interval in the panel; log a drink whenever you do.
water.notificationBody: Take a sip and rest for a moment.

skin.title: Skins & accessories
skin.hint: Skin packs contain only images and a manifest (PNG/JSON), never executable code. Import from a .zip file or a folder; store listing will be connected later.
skin.importDialogTitle: Choose a skin pack (.zip or folder)

data.exportHint: Export chat history as a Markdown or JSON file, saved to the location you choose.
data.clearHint: Permanently delete local data. This cannot be undone.
data.confirmDetail: This will permanently delete local data and cannot be undone.

share.unmasked: Shared cards automatically hide API keys and local paths.
